A.explanation: The magnitude $2.0\text{ m}$ is correct for displacement, but displacement is a vector and must include the direction from X to Y.

B.explanation: Displacement is the straight line from X to Y, equal to the diameter $2 \times 1.0\text{ m} = 2.0\text{ m}$ directed due south.

C.explanation: About $3.1\text{ m}$ is the distance travelled along the semi-circle, $\pi \times 1.0\text{ m}$, not the straight-line displacement.

D.explanation: About $3.1\text{ m}$ is the curved path length, so adding due south does not make it the displacement.
